input.summary: parts/shell.mjs builds the brick shell: front, rear, end and party walls with andesite plinth. It also lays sandstone string courses at y 18 and the y 23 eaves band, the y 13 and y 18 plank floors, flat partitions, the keeper partition and corner quoins. make.sh runs clean with no REFUSED writes or off-palette blocks. I did not look at the rendered tiles.
left: Stair flights are not in the shell: the stairs part must build them. The wells are left open (y 13 over x22..23 z10..15, y 18 over x22..23 z12..16).
Left open for later parts: shop fronts, fascia and console cells, end pilasters (x 3 and x 21, z 19, y 6..12), and all window, oriel, door and fanlight openings.
The y 6 floor is only laid outside the socket boxes (the aisles); the stair bay y 6 floor is not laid.

Quoins are on the x 3 and x 26 corners and at z 3 and z 18 on the end faces. I did not review the render, and `mcd sockets check` printed only its usage line when run bare, so it did not run. Its arguments still need working out.

waste.what: Worked out wall opening rectangles by hand, then discovered runParts' socket reservations also refuse writes into air inside the socket boxes
waste.tool: a helper that returns the free (unreserved, air) cells of a box, or a wall helper that takes a list of openings to leave out

waste.what: Filled floors and walls cell by cell with predicates, because brickWall cannot skip openings

companions.task: flights in the stair bay and the carved wells at y 13 and y 18
quoin pattern, sills and lintels over the openings
